approach: Two small changes at the two points where the cause starts. (1) In crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs, `producer_brief_with_evidence` (line 682) gains a new section, "How the verifier checks each criterion", placed after `checkable_evidence_section()` (line 743) and before `criteria_check_section` (line 744). It lists one line per accepted criterion, keyed by its number in "## Acceptance criteria" and not by its text, so the exact-text copy block is untouched. The line comes from a new pure function `verifier_check_hint(text, kind)`. A Content criterion gets "a named file or diff line: cite the path and line". A Behavior criterion gets "a command that ran: cite the exact command and what it printed; the verifier runs it itself". A criterion that says every mention / no longer appears / no remaining / zero remaining gets an added repo-wide Grep with zero remaining hits (cite the pattern and the empty result). A rewrapped-prose criterion (line width, wrap) gets an added line-width check on each changed file. The hint matchers only choose which hint lines are added. They refuse nothing, and a wrong match adds one sentence. (2) In crates/athena-core/src/run/producer.rs, the passing exit of the send-back loop (`break Some(report)` at line 555) sets the attempt's invocation `detail` to `self-check passed; redacted report: <json>`. The failing path already stores `self-check failed: ...; redacted report: <json>` (lines 616-630). So every attempt now stores the per-criterion check, status and evidence, and an introspection reader can see the criterion checked before the verdict. Record the root cause in a new decision D191 (heading `## D191 · ...`, with a Provenance bullet, and no 'amends' or 'supersedes' wording, so decision-links is untouched) and in a CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] entry. producer.md and budgets.rs are not edited: the information is in the brief, which sits outside the budgeted sets (system facts, "Prompt sets and budgets"). Any byte change to producer.md would also move the `budget producer: 1043 of 1200` line in docs/system-facts.md, and that file is not a deliverable. The producer lists both files in `unchanged_planned_files` with this reason. No refusal rule is added, so no refused-reading share applies.

decisions.choice: Put the hint in its own section before `criteria_check: copy the line`, keyed by criterion number, and do not echo the criterion text.
decisions.reason: Existing tests read the criteria_check section as ending with the bare criterion lines (briefs.rs:1658-1663) and assert its wording (1721-1735). A new section leaves them as they are. Not echoing the text keeps the exact-copy rule clean and adds no second copy to drift from.

rejected.option: Append the hint to each bare criterion line
rejected.why: It breaks the 'copy the line character for character' rule and the test at briefs.rs:1658-1663.
The prompt set is budgeted (1043 of 1200), the hint is per job, and a change there moves the system-facts budget line in a non-deliverable file.

decisions.choice: Store the report on the passing attempt in the same `detail` field and the same `...; redacted report: <json>` shape the failing path uses, with the prefix `self-check passed`.
decisions.reason: The field is `Option<String>` (athena-data records.rs:768) and the invocation record already goes into the job's records. Readers of a producer's `detail` (producer.rs:408 and 420) read it only for a non-success outcome, so a success is unaffected. The test at run_pin_tests.rs:1798-1800 already parses this shape. No new record or file is added, so check_record_file, AnyRecord and the round-trip test are untouched.

rejected.option: A new record or field for the check
rejected.why: It needs schema, round-trip and loader changes for data the detail already holds.

rejected.option: A refusal when the evidence is empty or does not match a sweep
rejected.why: The request prefers information to refusal. The hint tells the producer what the verifier looks for, and the send-back loop is unchanged.

decisions.choice: Exit table for the producer loop (producer.rs). Only the all-clear exit changes.
decisions.reason:
- Success, all clear (line 555 `break Some(report)`): CHANGED. The attempt's detail is set to `self-check passed; ...`; the next reader is the Reported struct (line 714), then the verifier brief and the records commit.
- Problems, send back (676-713): unchanged; detail is `self-check failed` (621); the next attempt starts from the send-back brief.
- Problems at the send-back limit (674): unchanged; detail is `self-check failed`, then `report_gaps` and `report_kept_in` go to the verifier.
- Timed out (407-418): unchanged; detail is the deadline text, read by `keep_unfinished_work`.
- Invocation not Success (419-439): unchanged; `producer_stop_reason` reads the detail.
- Could not run (394-398): unchanged; no record.
- Build-slot wait held (444-447): unchanged; returns Err.
- No valid report (448-457): unchanged; `self.failure`.
- Format step stopped (461-464) and records run unreachable (536-539): unchanged; `self.failure`.
- Interrupt: the closing code writes `interrupted_record` (invocation.rs:269); the new detail is set only after the invocation returns, so it is unaffected.

decisions.choice: The hint matchers are plain lowercase phrase lists in briefs.rs (sweep: every mention, every place, every occurrence, all mentions, no longer appear, no longer used, no remaining, zero remaining, nowhere; wrap: line width, wrap). They are not added to the reading checks.
decisions.reason: They only choose which hint sentences are added; no input is refused, so the refusal corpus (crates/athena-core/tests/refusal_corpus.rs) does not apply. Input forms are covered by unit tests in briefs.rs: sweep, wrap, plain content, behavior, and a mixed-case phrase.

rejected.why: Their meaning (a file-scope limit, Athena-only checks) differs from the sweep hint, and send_back.rs is in athena-core, which athena-context cannot reach (system facts, crate reach).

files.purpose: Add `verifier_check_hint(text, kind)` (pure) and a `verifier_checks_section` rendered in `producer_brief_with_evidence` after `checkable_evidence_section` and before `criteria_check_section`. Add the unit test `producer_brief_says_how_the_verifier_checks_each_criterion`.

At the all-clear exit (line 555), set the attempt's invocation detail to `self-check passed; redacted report: <json>` before `break Some(report)`, so every attempt stores its per-criterion check, status and evidence.
Add the test `a_passing_attempt_stores_the_per_criterion_check_in_its_invocation_detail`, next to line 5148.
Append D191 (Case, Decision, Alternatives, Tradeoff, Reversal cost, Provenance) naming the root cause and the fix.
Add an [Unreleased] 'Changed' entry naming the root cause, the fix in `producer_brief_with_evidence` and the stored per-attempt check, and the tests.

steps: Read briefs.rs lines 676-753 and 831-867 and the neighbouring tests at 1605-1736. In briefs.rs add `fn verifier_check_hint(text: &str, kind: CriterionKind) -> String`. A Content criterion gets 'a named file or diff line: cite the path and line'. A Behavior criterion gets 'a command that ran: cite the exact command and what it printed; the verifier runs it itself'. If the lowercased text holds a sweep phrase (every mention, every place, every occurrence, all mentions, no longer appear, no longer used, no remaining, zero remaining, nowhere), add 'a repo-wide search with zero remaining hits: Grep the whole repository for the old wording and cite the pattern and the empty result'. If it holds a wrap phrase (line width, wrap), add 'a line-width check: search each changed file for a line longer than the file's own widest unchanged line and cite the empty result'. Avoid the substrings '0.8', 'p10', 'cost' and any banned word in the text.

Add `fn verifier_checks_section(out, reading)` that writes `## How the verifier checks each criterion`, a short intro (the verifier sees only the diff and the commands it runs; a criterion only Athena's recorded checks can show is judged from those checks, see criteria_check below; nothing here is a new check), then `Criterion N: <hint>` for each criterion by its number in '## Acceptance criteria'. Call it in `producer_brief_with_evidence` after `checkable_evidence_section()` (line 743) and before `criteria_check_section` (line 744). Add the unit test `producer_brief_says_how_the_verifier_checks_each_criterion` (demonstration 3).

In producer.rs at the all-clear branch (line 545-556), before `break Some(report)`, set `closing.new_invocations.last_mut().expect(...).detail = Some(format!("self-check passed; redacted report: {}", serde_json::to_string(&report)?))`, with a comment naming the root cause (the passing attempt kept no record of the criteria check). Do not touch the failing path (616-630), the send-back text or `unmet_criteria`.
Add `a_passing_attempt_stores_the_per_criterion_check_in_its_invocation_detail` to run/tests.rs next to line 5148, as in demonstration 4.

Append D191 to docs/decisions.md after D190 (line 5688), headed `## D191 · The producer brief says how the verifier checks each criterion, and every attempt stores its criteria check`, with Case (the failure class and the three jobs 20261014-170031-2r9b, 20261014-172342-rqgb and 20261014-174937-hrzn, whose earlier edits are not redone), Decision, Alternatives, Tradeoff, Reversal cost and Provenance (files read, tests run, what was not measured). Add the CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] 'Changed' entry.

Run `cargo test -p athena-context`, `cargo test -p athena-core`, `cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets`, then `cargo fmt --all --check` and `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`. In the report list crates/athena-context/prompts/producer.md and crates/athena-cli/tests/budgets.rs in `unchanged_planned_files`, saying the hint is in the brief, outside the budgeted sets.

risks.risk: A phrase list that over-matches (for example 'wrap') adds a needless hint sentence, or one that under-matches misses a sweep criterion.
risks.mitigation: The hint matchers only add hint sentences, they refuse nothing, and the unit test covers a plain criterion that gets neither the sweep nor the width hint.

risks.risk: Storing the report on every attempt grows invocation records and the records branch.
risks.mitigation: The detail holds the already-redacted report (producer.rs:512 redacts before this point). The failing path stores the same size of text at producer.rs:621-625, and the stored shape is the one the failing path already uses.

risks.risk: A longer producer brief carries more tokens, and the existing tests that assert on the brief break.
risks.mitigation: Per-criterion lines are short, and the hint wording avoids the forecast words. The tests that read the criteria_check section are not changed, and the budgets test is run in demonstration 6.

risks.risk: The producer still reports 'met' without evidence, because the hint is information, not a gate.
risks.mitigation: The change makes the check visible and tells the producer what the verifier looks for. It does not stop a wrong 'met'. A verifier-side repair loop is out of scope in the request. The D191 Tradeoff states the limit, and the share of failures the hint prevents is not measured.

risks.risk: Expected deliverables producer.md and budgets.rs are left unchanged and flagged as gaps.
risks.mitigation: The producer lists producer.md and budgets.rs in `unchanged_planned_files` with the reason, which the unchanged-files check accepts (producer.rs:484). Demonstration 6 shows the diff stat for them is empty.

demonstrations.method: A unit test in the briefs.rs test module, written after `producer_briefs_list_every_criterion_to_copy_and_ask_for_one_entry_each` (line 1640). It calls the production `producer_brief` on `ProducerInputs` built as in the neighbouring tests. The reading is `AcceptedReading::new(&reading(), &defaults(), |_| false)` with its public `criteria` field replaced by four criteria: a content criterion that says every mention of the old figure is updated, a behavior criterion that names a command, a content criterion about rewrapped prose and line width, and a plain content criterion. It takes the new section and asserts: criterion 1 has 'repo-wide search' and 'zero remaining hits'; criterion 2 has 'a command that ran'; criterion 3 has 'line width'; criterion 4 has 'file or diff line' and neither the sweep nor the width hint; the section sits before the criteria_check heading; the brief still has none of '0.97', 'p10' or 'cost' (the hint wording avoids those).
demonstrations.observes: The test passes with the change. It panics on the base tree for the missing heading.
demonstrations.fails_without: On the base tree the brief has no 'How the verifier checks each criterion' section, so the `split_once` on that heading fails and the test panics. Removing only the sweep branch of `verifier_check_hint` fails the assertion for 'repo-wide search' and 'zero remaining hits'. Removing only the behavior branch fails the 'a command that ran' assertion.
demonstrations.seam: Production entry point `producer_brief` (briefs.rs:676) through `producer_brief_with_evidence`. The fixture is the `reading()` and `defaults()` helpers of the briefs.rs test module (lines 1605-1607), which exist. `AcceptedReading.criteria` is a pub field (line 80), so the test sets the criteria with no double. The hint logic runs in production code; plan step 1 adds `verifier_check_hint` and the section.

demonstrations.method: A new test in crates/athena-core/src/run/tests.rs, placed next to `a_failing_check_is_sent_back_before_the_verifier_and_the_fix_reaches_it` (line 5148). It runs a whole job through `athena.go` with `run_checked_job` (line 5128) on `repo()`, with a check that passes (`marked_check("exit 0", &marker)`) and the script `editing(counts, prompts, Vec::new())` (line 3567). The fake producer reports every criterion as met with evidence. The test loads `Records::load(&athena.git, &athena.head().unwrap())` as at lines 5191-5198 and takes the producer invocations. It asserts there is exactly one (counts.all() gives producer 1, so no send-back), and that its `detail` contains 'self-check passed' and 'redacted report: '. It parses the JSON after that text into `athena_data::records::ProducerReport`, as run_pin_tests.rs:1799-1800 does, and asserts one criteria_check entry per reading criterion, each with status 'met' and non-empty evidence.
demonstrations.observes: The stored detail of a passing producer attempt carries the criterion, its status and its evidence.
demonstrations.fails_without: On the base tree the passing attempt's `detail` is None (it is set only at producer.rs:621 on the failing path), so `unwrap_or_default()` is empty and the `contains("self-check passed")` assertion fails. Without the change in this plan the stored attempt has no criteria_check.
